input.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
input.rationale: The only liability limitation in the Agreement (§12, p0077) protects TrueLink alone: it caps TrueLink's liability at 12 months' hosting and support compensation, while Client's liability — including its very broad indemnity in §12a covering any breach, Client Content and third-party claims — is entirely uncapped. There is no mutual cap, no exclusion of indirect/consequential damages, and no set of mutual carve-outs (only gross negligence/wilful misconduct on TrueLink's side). One-sided capping with the Customer uncapped is walk-away territory under the rule, so this fails the fallback (mutual 12-month cap with carve-outs). Our redline edits the existing sentence only: it makes the cap mutual and applies it across the Agreement at the greater of 12 months' compensation and USD 1,000,000, places indemnification, confidentiality/data-security breaches, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap for both parties, and confirms Client's payment obligations are not capped damages. We did not add a separate consequential-damages exclusion, as the cap plus carve-outs delivers the material protection.

proposal.summary: Make the liability cap mutual, apply it across the Agreement, add standard uncapped carve-outs and preserve Client's payment obligations outside the cap.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is a mutual cap set at the greater of twelve months' fees and USD 1,000,000, so we have added Client to the cap rather than leaving our exposure unlimited while TrueLink's is limited. Indemnification, confidentiality/data-security breaches, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap for both parties, and Client's payment obligations are not capped damages.

ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID OR PAYABLE FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD AND (B) USD 1,000,000. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS UNDER SECTION 12, ITS BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. CLIENT'S OBLIGATION TO PAY COMPENSATION DUE UNDER SECTION 5 SHALL NOT BE TREATED AS DAMAGES SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION.
